quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الٓر ۚ كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ
ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ

وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنجَىٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌۭ
وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌۭ
وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِن تَكْفُرُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ ۛ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۛ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِىٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَنَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍۢ

۞ قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ أَفِى ٱللَّهِ شَكٌّۭ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأْتُونَا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ إِن نَّحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيْتُمُونَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِنَآ أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا ۖ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
وَٱسْتَفْتَحُوا۟ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٍۢ صَدِيدٍۢ
يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍۢ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌۭ
مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ

وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًۭا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَٰكُمْ ۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَجَزِعْنَآ أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍۢ

وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ
أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا كَلِمَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ كَشَجَرَةٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌۭ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍۢ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍۢ
يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ
۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفْرًۭا وَأَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ
جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ
وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌۭ

وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍۢ
وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍۢ
يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍۢ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

parent_channels.name: P1 (14:1-15): Message Made Visible and Traversable

subchannels.name: Extraction from Cover into Light
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written and delivered message draws people out of concealment and makes its content appear under illumination.
subchannels.active_motifs: written letters/book `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; lowering as delivery `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; extraction from concealment `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`; disappearance under cover `quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`; blocking or concealing truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; illumination `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`; appearance and disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:1-5: كِتَابٌ، أَنزَلْنَاهُ، لِتُخْرِجَ، الظُّلُمَاتِ، النُّورِ، الْكَافِرِينَ، ضَلَالٍ، لِيُبَيِّنَ، أَخْرِجْ.
subchannels.synthesis: The message is not only information. Its lexical scene is a transfer that reaches a covered location, removes its occupants, and places both people and meaning in light. Concealment, denial, and straying are therefore spatial resistance to disclosure.

subchannels.name: Route Orientation and Obstruction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler is aligned to an extended, clear road while obstruction, bending, and wandering deform access to it.
subchannels.active_motifs: straight road `quranic:root_000858:B001/m01`; extended path `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; road leading to water `quranic:root_000848:B004/m01`; physical bending `quranic:root_001057:B001/m01`; semantic deviation `quranic:root_001057:B002/m01`; wandering from the way `quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`; gentle direction to a path `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; clear road across easy ground `quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`; guiding beacon `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`; public thoroughfare and alignment `quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:1-3, 9, 12: النُّورِ، صِرَاطِ، يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ، يَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا، ضَلَالٍ، يَأْتِكُمْ، نَبَؤُا، هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا.
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance is staged as practical orientation: a straight, extended, conspicuous route with a beacon and even access to water. The opposing operations are not one generic error but blockage, imposed curvature, and loss of bearing.

subchannels.name: Embodied and Local Transmission
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dispatched messenger carries a report into the hearers' own speech, articulates it bodily, and makes its force locally intelligible.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatching `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; messenger and carried message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; language and speech `quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`; linguistic delivery of a message `quranic:root_001355:B008/m01`; disclosure by speech or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; mouth opening in speech `quranic:root_001190:B003/m01`; uttered speech `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; quiet imparting `quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`; divinely imparted report `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`; receptive hearing `quranic:root_000022:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:4, 9, 11, 13: أَرْسَلْنَا، رَسُولٍ، بِلِسَانِ، لِيُبَيِّنَ، رُسُلُهُمْ، أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، قَالُوا، أُرْسِلْتُمْ، بِإِذْنِ، لِرُسُلِهِمْ، فَأَوْحَى.
subchannels.synthesis: Dispatch, language, mouth, utterance, and receptive hearing form one communication circuit. Revelation reaches a community by being embodied in its speech, while quiet imparting to the messengers feeds the public act of clarification.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Guidance converts what is concealed into something publicly perceptible, linguistically transmissible, and spatially followable.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:1-5, 9-12: كِتَابٌ، أَنزَلْنَاهُ، لِتُخْرِجَ، الظُّلُمَاتِ، النُّورِ، صِرَاطِ، سَبِيلِ، بِلِسَانِ، لِيُبَيِّنَ، أَرْسَلْنَا، رُسُلُهُمْ، أُرْسِلْتُمْ، تَدْعُونَنَا، سُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ، هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lexical branches materialize revelation as extraction from cover, road engineering, a route to water, a public thoroughfare, oral articulation, and a quietly imparted report.

parent_channels.name: P1 (14:1-15): Coercive Extraction Reversed into Settlement

subchannels.name: Coercive Butchery and Selective Preservation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dominant household imposes injury by slaughtering one line, preserving another, and using the asymmetry as a trial.
subchannels.active_motifs: imposing an evil burden `quranic:root_000764:B002/m01`; painful punishment `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; slitting the throat `quranic:root_000508:B001/m01`; offspring and lineage `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; women `quranic:root_001500:B001/m01`; preserving life by leaving un-killed `quranic:root_000383:B006/m01`; deliverance by separation `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`; stripping or extraction `quranic:root_001476:B003/m01`; trial that exposes condition `quranic:root_000153:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:6-7: أَنجَاكُم، يَسُومُونَكُمْ، سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ، يُذَبِّحُونَ، أَبْنَاءَكُمْ، يَسْتَحْيُونَ، نِسَاءَكُمْ، بَلَاءٌ، عَذَابِي.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene separates coercion into precise acts rather than a general oppression: injury is imposed, throats are cut, descendants are selected, and some lives are deliberately retained. Deliverance reverses the same mechanics by separating and extracting the exposed community.

subchannels.name: Forced Return versus Reallotted Dwelling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Threatened expulsion and coerced return are answered by the removal of oppressors and the settlement of the displaced in land.
subchannels.active_motifs: coercion `quranic:root_000216:B003/m01`; exit and removal `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; land and estrangement `quranic:root_000025:B004/m01`; return after departure `quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`; inhabiting and settling `quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`; ruin `quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`; expected harm and fear `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`; articulated threat `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:13-15: لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُمْ، أَرْضِنَا، لَتَعُودُنَّ، لَنُهْلِكَنَّ، لَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الْأَرْضَ، خَافَ، وَعِيدِ، جَبَّارٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: Both parties contest the same movement and place. The coercive regime claims authority to eject or force return; the answer removes that regime and turns the threatened outsiders into settled inhabitants.

subchannels.name: Opening as Verdict
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opposed parties seek an opening; the opening becomes judicial decision and victory, while the tyrant's intended outcome fails.
subchannels.active_motifs: opening as judicial decision `quranic:root_001124:B003/m01`; opening as victory `quranic:root_001124:B004/m01`; failed aim and deprivation `quranic:root_000451:B001/m01`; ruin `quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`; obstinate deviation `quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:13, 15: لَنُهْلِكَنَّ، اسْتَفْتَحُوا، خَابَ، جَبَّارٍ، عَنِيدٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: The requested “opening” is activated as both access and adjudication. What opens for the petitioners closes the tyrant's project: obstinate force reaches deprivation rather than its intended victory.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human power expels, strips, and threatens; divine deliverance separates people from that pressure and reallocates land and outcome.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:6, 13-15: أَنجَاكُم، يَسُومُونَكُمْ، يُذَبِّحُونَ، يَسْتَحْيُونَ، بَلَاءٌ، لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُمْ، أَرْضِنَا، لَتَعُودُنَّ، لَنُهْلِكَنَّ، لَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الْأَرْضَ، وَعِيدِ، اسْتَفْتَحُوا، خَابَ، جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The interval turns political persecution into a set of physical operations: slaughter, preservation, stripping, forced movement, resettlement, and finally the opening of a judicial passage.

parent_channels.name: P1 (14:1-15): Contested Delegation and Entrusted Endurance

subchannels.name: Evidence Meets Bodily Refusal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clear evidence arrives, but hearers reject it bodily and experience doubt as something penetrating and disturbing their interior order.
subchannels.active_motifs: clarity and disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; rejection and non-acceptance `quranic:root_000555:B003/m01`; hand as operative limb `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; mouth as bodily aperture `quranic:root_001190:B001/m01`; doubt as interpenetration `quranic:root_000812:B001/m01`; piercing or organizing insertion `quranic:root_000812:B002/m01`; disturbed doubt `quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`; compelling proof `quranic:root_000732:B002/m01`; visible human skin `quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:9-10: بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ، فَرَدُّوا، أَيْدِيَهُمْ، أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، كَفَرْنَا، شَكٍّ، مُرِيبٍ، بَشَرٌ، بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: The response to proof is rendered as an embodied counter-motion: hands and mouths participate in refusal, while doubt enters and disorders. The bodily image usefully pressures a purely propositional reading of disbelief.

subchannels.name: Authority Held by Permission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human messengers carry proof and report, but effective authority remains contingent on permission from the commissioning lord.
subchannels.active_motifs: messenger and message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; visible human embodiment `quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`; compelling proof `quranic:root_000732:B002/m01`; power and authority `quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`; authorization `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`; lordship and nurture `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; divinely imparted report `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:10-11, 13: رُسُلُهُمْ، بَشَرٌ، بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ، بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ، رَبُّهُمْ، فَأَوْحَى.
subchannels.synthesis: Proof, authority, permission, and revelation form a delegated chain. The messenger's ordinary embodiment does not cancel the commission; it locates power outside the human carrier and prevents the sign from becoming personal possession.

subchannels.name: Reliance as Entrusting under Injury
subchannels.scene_or_process: The messengers hand the threatened matter to a sufficient guardian, restrain panic, and continue along their assigned paths under injury.
subchannels.active_motifs: handing a matter over `quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`; reliance `quranic:root_001681:B002/m01`; guardian sufficiency `quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`; heart-security and trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; restraining the self from panic `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; distress with no visible exit `quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`; harmful injury or speech `quranic:root_000023:B001/m01`; guidance to a path `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; anticipated harm `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:11-14: فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ، نَتَوَكَّلَ، هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا، لَنَصْبِرَنَّ، آذَيْتُمُونَا، الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ، خَافَ.
subchannels.synthesis: Reliance is a transfer of custody under real pressure. Endurance then appears as controlled continuation through injury and apparent enclosure, not denial that harm or fear exists.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Messenger authority is delegated rather than possessed, so refusal cannot be answered by autonomous force but by evidence, permission, trust, and endurance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:9-12: بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ، فَرَدُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، شَكٍّ مُرِيبٍ، بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا، بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ، بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ، فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ، هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا، لَنَصْبِرَنَّ، آذَيْتُمُونَا.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Refusal becomes bodily recoil and invasive doubt, while reliance becomes the transfer of a matter to a sufficient guardian rather than passive optimism.

parent_channels.name: P2 (14:16-27): Blocked Intake and Suspended Death

subchannels.name: Tainted Watering
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recipient is watered, but the administered liquid is a hated, diseased substance rather than a life-giving share.
subchannels.active_motifs: quenching thirst `quranic:root_000722:B001/m01`; providing drink `quranic:root_000722:B002/m01`; irrigation share or channel `quranic:root_000722:B003/m01`; drenching the heart with a hated thing `quranic:root_000722:B010/m01`; water `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; pouring or delivering water `quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`; festering abscess and pus `quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`; body refusing food or drink `quranic:root_000994:B002/m01`; disease consuming the interior `quranic:root_001642:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:16-17, 19, 26: مِنْ وَرَائِهِ، يُسْقَى، مَاءٍ، صَدِيدٍ، عَذَابٌ، الْأَرْضَ، الْأَرْضِ.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene reverses irrigation. A measured share is delivered, yet its material is suppurating and internally destructive; the same act that ordinarily restores life becomes forced intake of corruption.

subchannels.name: Throat Passage under Failure
subchannels.scene_or_process: The sufferer takes repeated measured gulps, but the liquid cannot achieve smooth passage through the throat.
subchannels.active_motifs: swallowed gulp `quranic:root_000237:B001/m01`; chin or last-breath posture `quranic:root_000237:B004/m01`; smooth throat passage `quranic:root_000761:B001/m01`; laborious attempt `quranic:root_001329:B001/m01`; nearing an action `quranic:root_001329:B002/m01`; inability under negation `quranic:root_001329:B003/m01`; administered sips `quranic:root_001188:B007/m01`; oppressive thickness `quranic:root_001099:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:17, 26: يَتَجَرَّعُهُ، لَا يَكَادُ، يُسِيغُهُ، عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ، فَوْقِ.
subchannels.synthesis: Gulp, dosage, near-performance, failed swallowing, and thickness isolate the operation at issue. Punishment is materialized as perpetual almost-ingestion: the body repeatedly approaches completion but cannot complete it.

subchannels.name: Death Arrives but Does Not Discharge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Death approaches from every side and deadens the body, yet the terminal decree and its release remain withheld.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival `quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`; loss of life and strength `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; deadening of the heart `quranic:root_001454:B006/m01`; fainting or swoon `quranic:root_001454:B009/m01`; bodily stillness `quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`; death as rest or release `quranic:root_000609:B016/m01`; death decree `quranic:root_001237:B003/m01`; the side behind or beyond `quranic:root_001642:B006/m01`; breath issuing from the interior `quranic:root_001533:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:17-18, 22: يَأْتِيهِ، الْمَوْتُ، كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، مَيِّتٍ، مِنْ وَرَائِهِ، الرِّيحُ، قُضِيَ، أَنْفُسَكُمْ.
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival, breath, deadening, swoon, and stillness accumulate signs of dying, but death's decisive and relieving function does not occur. The result is a body held in a recurrent terminal state.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What should sustain life enters as hostile matter, fails to pass through the body, and holds the sufferer at the threshold of death without release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:16-17: يُسْقَى، مَاءٍ صَدِيدٍ، يَتَجَرَّعُهُ، لَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُ، يَأْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ، وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ، عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Watering, irrigation share, dosage, throat mechanics, breath, interior disease, stillness, and death-as-rest build a physiological scene of denied nourishment and denied termination.

parent_channels.name: P2 (14:16-27): Supports Exposed and Withdrawn

subchannels.name: Work Dispersed as Ash and Chaff
subchannels.scene_or_process: Accumulated work is reduced to light residue and carried away by a violent wind, leaving no recoverable gain.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; ash `quranic:root_000598:B002/m01`; wind `quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`; wind as force `quranic:root_000609:B011/m01`; chaff or husk `quranic:root_001020:B001/m01`; gale `quranic:root_001020:B002/m01`; sweeping destruction `quranic:root_001020:B004/m01`; strength `quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`; capacity `quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`; acquired gain `quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`; loss `quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:18, 20: أَعْمَالُهُمْ، رَمَادٍ، اشْتَدَّتْ، الرِّيحُ، عَاصِفٍ، لَا يَقْدِرُونَ، كَسَبُوا، بِعَزِيزٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: The image distinguishes production from durability. Work and gain can exist, yet when reduced to ash or husk they have no cohesion against the gale; power is registered precisely as the inability to retain what was acquired.

subchannels.name: Creation Removed and Replaced
subchannels.scene_or_process: A formed creation can be dismissed, and a newly cut beginning can be brought forward in its place.
subchannels.active_motifs: measuring `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; creating `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; completing a form `quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`; departure and removal `quranic:root_000522:B006/m01`; bringing into arrival `quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`; newness after a cut `quranic:root_000227:B004/m01`; exposure `quranic:root_000105:B001/m01`; gathering `quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:19, 21: خَلَقَ، يُذْهِبْكُمْ، يَأْتِ، بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ، بَرَزُوا، جَمِيعًا.
subchannels.synthesis: Creation is pictured as measured formation rather than an untouchable possession. Removal cuts one continuity; arrival and new formation establish another, anticipating the exposed gathering that follows.

subchannels.name: Hierarchy without Load-Bearing Power
subchannels.scene_or_process: Followers seek protection from their former superiors, but rank cannot carry liability, avert punishment, or open an escape.

subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:21: بَرَزُوا، جَمِيعًا، الضُّعَفَاءُ، اسْتَكْبَرُوا، تَبَعًا، مُغْنُونَ، سَوَاءٌ، مَحِيصٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering exposes the social frame as a failed support system. Following created liability but no reciprocal capacity; once rank is tested by punishment, panic and endurance become equal because neither opens an exit.

subchannels.name: Promise, Call, and Failed Rescue
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claimant opens hope through a promise and summons, breaks the promise after compliance, and disclaims both authority and rescue.

subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:22: قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ، وَعَدَكُمْ، وَعْدَ، وَعَدْتُكُمْ، أَخْلَفْتُكُمْ، سُلْطَانٍ، دَعَوْتُكُمْ، اسْتَجَبْتُمْ، تَلُومُونِي، مُصْرِخِكُمْ، أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ، كَفَرْتُ.
subchannels.synthesis: The speech reconstructs deception as a failed contract and rescue relation. The call secures compliance without coercive authority; once the decree is complete, promise, partnership, and mutual rescue are explicitly severed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Works, created continuities, and social dependencies appear stable until the force supporting them is withdrawn and their inability to bear weight is exposed.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:18-22: أَعْمَالُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ، اشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيحُ، يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ، لَا يَقْدِرُونَ، كَسَبُوا، يُذْهِبْكُمْ، خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ، بَرَزُوا، الضُّعَفَاءُ، اسْتَكْبَرُوا، تَبَعًا، مُغْنُونَ، مَحِيصٍ، وَعَدَكُمْ، أَخْلَفْتُكُمْ، سُلْطَانٍ، دَعَوْتُكُمْ، اسْتَجَبْتُمْ، مُصْرِخِكُمْ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Chaff, gale, exposed ground, liability, broken promises, and failed rescue translate moral loss into structural failure across material, created, and political supports.

parent_channels.name: P2 (14:16-27): Rooted Speech as Living Provision

subchannels.name: Garden Flow and Peaceful Permanence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Entrants inhabit a concealed garden whose water and provision continue beneath a stable greeting of safety.

subchannels.name: Word-Tree Architecture

subchannels.synthesis: Speech becomes an organism with differentiated parts and directions. Intelligibility and purity name its quality; root, stable base, and elevated branch explain how it persists while reaching beyond its point of origin.

subchannels.name: Timed Fruit as Allocated Share
subchannels.scene_or_process: The rooted organism repeatedly produces an edible share at its appointed season under authorization.

subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:25: تُؤْتِي، أُكُلَهَا، كُلَّ، حِينٍ، بِإِذْنِ.
subchannels.synthesis: Stability is productive rather than static. A timed cycle converts rooted life into a recurring allotted share, so the good word's value lies in dependable nourishment as well as enduring form.

subchannels.name: Uprooted Speech without Resting Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: A corrupt word is compared to a corrupt tree torn out from its origin and left without a stable bottom.

subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:26: كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ، شَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ، اجْتُثَّتْ، فَوْقِ الْأَرْضِ، قَرَارٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: The contrast isolates a different operation and outcome from ordinary fruiting. The whole organism is severed at origin, placed only above the ground, and denied the lower support required for continuity.

subchannels.name: Human Fixing through Stable Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stable speech reinforces the believer's interior and verbal posture across present and later life.

subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:27: يُثَبِّتُ، آمَنُوا، بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ، الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا، الْآخِرَةِ، يُضِلُّ.
subchannels.synthesis: The tree's stable base is transferred to human cognition and speech. Fixing is an active reinforcement that carries the believer through two temporal settings, while misdirection names the loss of that orientation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Beneficial speech and faithful life share an architecture of rooted stability, upward extension, timed yield, and enduring habitation.

parent_channels.name: P3 (14:28-41): Misplaced Exchange and Ruined Dwelling

subchannels.synthesis: The rivals operate as route-altering counterparts. Their benefit is real enough to be used but temporally bounded; the path's final conversion into fire discloses the cost hidden by present enjoyment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A beneficial allotment is deliberately exchanged for its contrary, and the altered valuation materializes as a damaged destination for a whole people.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Exchange becomes land degradation: substitution does not merely change belief but settles a population in stagnation, barrenness, decay, and fire.

parent_channels.name: P3 (14:28-41): Provision as Circulating Infrastructure

subchannels.scene_or_process: Allocated provision exits through visible and concealed channels before a day when sale and social exchange no longer operate.

subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:31-33: يَوْمٌ، الْفُلْكَ، سَخَّرَ، الشَّمْسَ، الْقَمَرَ، دَائِبَيْنِ، اللَّيْلَ، النَّهَارَ.
subchannels.synthesis: The celestial bodies and alternating times are workers within the same provision system. Their repeated circulation and the opening of daylight make temporal regularity another infrastructure made available to human life.

subchannels.name: Gifts beyond Exhaustive Enumeration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Requests meet giving across a total field of needs, but the resulting benefits exceed the recipient's capacity to count or close the account.

subchannels.synthesis: Giving answers asking, yet the total granted field cannot be reduced to a completed inventory. Counting and exhaustive enumeration are activated only to fail, reframing abundance as an account whose entries continue beyond human closure.

parent_channels.name: P3 (14:28-41): Sanctuary Household as Cultivated Continuity

subchannels.name: Settlement in an Uncultivated Watercourse
subchannels.scene_or_process: Part of a lineage is fixed near the sacred house in a valley capable of channeling water but presently without cultivation.
subchannels.active_motifs: settling `quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`; sustenance that fixes residence `quranic:root_000726:B010/m01`; tiny dispersed particle `quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`; valley as flood-course `quranic:root_001637:B005/m01`; cultivation `quranic:root_000630:B001/m01`; sheltering house `quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`; sanctuary boundary `quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`; ritual prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:37: أَسْكَنْتُ، ذُرِّيَّتِي، بِوَادٍ، غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ، عِنْدَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ، لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ.
subchannels.synthesis: Settlement is staged like planting under difficult hydrological conditions. The lineage is a small dispersed beginning placed in a flood-course without crops; house, sanctuary, prayer, and future sustenance are the supports intended to make residence hold.

subchannels.name: Hearts and Fruit Drawn Inward
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human interiors incline toward the settlers while fruit provision is drawn into the barren site, producing gratitude.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart as inner heat `quranic:root_001122:B002/m01`; desire and inclination `quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`; allotted provision `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; ripe fruit `quranic:root_000205:B001/m01`; recognition of blessing `quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`; people as community `quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:37: أَفْئِدَةً، مِنَ النَّاسِ، تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ، ارْزُقْهُمْ، الثَّمَرَاتِ، يَشْكُرُونَ.
subchannels.synthesis: Two inward motions answer the valley's lack: people incline affectively and fruit arrives materially. Social attachment and nourishment jointly make the settlement viable, with gratitude as their intended yield.

subchannels.name: Heard Gift across Old Age
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call is heard and answered by an unreciprocated gift of offspring after bodily aging.
subchannels.active_motifs: praise `quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`; gift without return `quranic:root_001685:B001/m01`; old age `quranic:root_001281:B004/m01`; hearing `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; hearing as understanding and response `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; call or prayer `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; lordship and nurture `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; offspring `quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`; tiny dispersed particle `quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:39-41: الْحَمْدُ، وَهَبَ، عَلَى الْكِبَرِ، إِسْمَاعِيلَ، إِسْحَاقَ، رَبِّي، سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ، دُعَاءِ، ذُرِّيَّتِي، لِوَالِدَيَّ.
subchannels.synthesis: Hearing is activated as responsive uptake rather than bare perception. The gift of descendants after old age answers the call and extends the small planted household beyond the petitioner's bodily horizon.

subchannels.name: Intergenerational Prayer toward Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: Prayer asks that worship stand, calls be accepted, and forgiveness extend through descendants, parents, and believers when the final account stands.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship and nurture `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; causing a state `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; bodily standing `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`; rising at resurrection `quranic:root_001273:B013/m01`; ritual prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; offspring `quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`; accepting and receiving `quranic:root_001198:B004/m01`; prayerful call `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; covering by forgiveness `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; parents `quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`; faith `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; decisive day `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; account `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:40-41: رَبِّ، اجْعَلْنِي، مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ، ذُرِّيَّتِي، تَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ، اغْفِرْ لِي، لِوَالِدَيَّ، لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ، يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ.
subchannels.synthesis: The repeated standing root joins prayer maintained in ordinary life to the rising of the account. Acceptance and forgiveness carry the household frame outward to ancestors and the wider believing community, making continuity accountable rather than merely genealogical.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A household is planted in bounded space so worship, safety, provision, responsive hearing, and lineage can continue across generations.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:35-41: الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا، اجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ، نَعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ، أَسْكَنْتُ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ، عِنْدَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ، يُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ، أَفْئِدَةً، تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ، ارْزُقْهُمْ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ، وَهَبَ لِي، سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ، مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي، تَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ، وَلِوَالِدَيَّ، يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The prayer resembles cultivation: a small dispersed household is fixed in a flood-course without crops, then sustained by inward-moving hearts, imported fruit, heard calls, and intergenerational acceptance.

parent_channels.name: P4 (14:42-52): Deferred Reckoning and Arrested Attention

subchannels.name: The Unneglected Ledger and Deferred Date
subchannels.scene_or_process: Observers miscalculate delay as inattention, but deeds remain marked until a fixed event exposes the unjust.
subchannels.active_motifs: supposing and calculating `quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`; account and reckoning `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`; inattentiveness `quranic:root_001097:B001/m01`; leaving something unrecorded or unmarked `quranic:root_001097:B002/m01`; intentional deeds `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; grievance and demand for redress `quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`; deferral `quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`; severe day or event `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; fixed staring `quranic:root_000781:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:42: تَحْسَبَنَّ، غَافِلًا، يَعْمَلُ، الظَّالِمُونَ، يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ، لِيَوْمٍ، تَشْخَصُ.
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical relation between heedlessness and an unmarked record sharpens the denial: postponement has not erased the entry. Miscalculation belongs to the observer, while the deferred date preserves the connection between deed and disclosure.

subchannels.name: Gaze and Head Locked Forward
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodies rush forward with raised heads and extended necks while sight remains fixed and cannot return through an ordinary blink.
subchannels.active_motifs: fixed stare `quranic:root_000781:B004/m01`; upward or arrested posture `quranic:root_000781:B002/m01`; vision `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; sustained gaze `quranic:root_001594:B001/m01`; extended neck and raised head `quranic:root_001594:B002/m01`; rushing forward `quranic:root_001594:B003/m01`; elevation without lowering `quranic:root_001263:B004/m01`; head or top `quranic:root_000529:B001/m01`; return `quranic:root_000555:B001/m01`; blink or edge of gaze `quranic:root_000931:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:42-43: تَشْخَصُ، الْأَبْصَارُ، مُهْطِعِينَ، مُقْنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمْ، لَا يَرْتَدُّ، طَرْفُهُمْ.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is kinematically exact: forward rush combines with vertical extension, while the eye is denied its tiny restorative return. Judgment arrests orientation itself, holding the body in compulsory attention.

subchannels.name: The Evacuated Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: The exterior remains rigidly directed while the heart loses strength and the interior becomes void.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart as inner heat `quranic:root_001122:B002/m01`; weakened or absent heart `quranic:root_001122:B004/m01`; void or air `quranic:root_001609:B001/m01`; hollow wound `quranic:root_001609:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: “Air” becomes an emptied interior rather than mere emotion. The contrast with the locked exterior is severe: posture is overdetermined, but the heart-space that would organize response has lost substance and heat.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Apparent delay is not neglect; when the marked time arrives, judgment arrests the body's ordinary control of gaze, posture, and interior composure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:42-43: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ، غَافِلًا، يَعْمَلُ الظَّالِمُونَ، يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ، تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ الْأَبْصَارُ، مُهْطِعِينَ، مُقْنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمْ، لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ، أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَوَاءٌ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Inattention also means failure to mark a record; terror then becomes a coordinated failure of eye return, head movement, blinking, heart-strength, and interior fullness.

parent_channels.name: P4 (14:42-52): Irreversible Return against Human Delay

subchannels.name: Late Plea for Call-and-Response
subchannels.scene_or_process: When warning materializes as arriving punishment, the unjust ask for a short delay in which they promise to answer the call and follow the messengers.
subchannels.active_motifs: warning `quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`; arrival `quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`; painful punishment `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; deferral `quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`; appointed term `quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`; nearness to expiry `quranic:root_001212:B002/m01`; answering a call `quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`; summons or prayer `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; following `quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`; messenger and message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:44: أَنْذِرِ، يَأْتِيهِمُ، الْعَذَابُ، أَخِّرْنَا، أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ، نُجِبْ، دَعْوَتَكَ، نَتَّبِعِ، الرُّسُلَ.
subchannels.synthesis: The plea attempts to reopen the communication circuit after its term has closed. Arrival converts warning into present fact; only then do answer and following become desired operations, but their requested time is itself deferred time.

subchannels.name: Oath of No Removal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prior oath asserts permanent residence and denies any movement from the present condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: oath and swearing `quranic:root_001226:B004/m01`; removal or change of place `quranic:root_000655:B001/m01`; motion after stillness `quranic:root_000655:B002/m01`; occurrence and coming-to-be `quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`; prior time `quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:44: تَكُونُوا، أَقْسَمْتُمْ، مِنْ قَبْلُ، مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ زَوَالٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: The oath tries to stabilize one historical condition indefinitely. The removal root activates both displacement and motion after rest, so the denial is not only of death but of any transition capable of breaking present possession.

subchannels.name: Inhabited Historical Proof
subchannels.scene_or_process: Later residents occupy the dwellings of self-wronging predecessors and encounter disclosed actions rendered visible through examples.
subchannels.active_motifs: inhabiting and settling `quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`; grievance and demand for redress `quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`; self `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; clarity and disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; performed action `quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`; rendering a visible example `quranic:root_000906:B003/m01`; parable as instructive sign `quranic:root_001397:B011/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:45: سَكَنْتُمْ، مَسَاكِنِ، ظَلَمُوا، أَنْفُسَهُمْ، تَبَيَّنَ، فَعَلْنَا، ضَرَبْنَا، الْأَمْثَالَ.
subchannels.synthesis: Historical knowledge is architectural and inhabited. The audience does not merely hear of prior action; it lives inside its surviving spatial result, where disclosure and parable make the predecessor's outcome present.

subchannels.name: Covert Irrigation against Mountain Resistance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A covert action behaves like irrigation capable of penetrating and spoiling growth, yet it confronts mountain material defined by resistance to excavation and cohesive density.
subchannels.active_motifs: irrigating land or crop `quranic:root_001438:B005/m01`; spoiled fresh fruit `quranic:root_001438:B006/m01`; removal from place `quranic:root_000655:B001/m01`; mountain as elevated solid mass `quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`; solidity that stops excavation `quranic:root_000217:B005/m01`; tightly woven density `quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`; hard cohesive ground `quranic:root_001008:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:46-47: مَكَرُوا، مَكْرَهُمْ، لِتَزُولَ، الْجِبَالُ، عَزِيزٌ.
subchannels.synthesis: The latent assembly usefully pressures the scale comparison. Plotting can enter indirectly like water and spoil fresh growth, but the object to be moved is simultaneously elevated mass, excavation-resistant substrate, and woven density on cohesive ground. The scene contrasts covert penetration with load-bearing cohesion.

subchannels.name: Promise That Cannot Be Broken
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promise to commissioned messengers carries both hope and threat, remains unbroken, and culminates in overpowering retribution.
subchannels.active_motifs: calculating or supposing `quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`; breaking a promise `quranic:root_000433:B005/m01`; promise opening hope `quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`; articulated threat `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`; messenger and message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; overwhelming might `quranic:root_001008:B002/m01`; retribution `quranic:root_001545:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:47: تَحْسَبَنَّ، مُخْلِفَ، وَعْدِهِ، رُسُلَهُ، عَزِيزٌ، انْتِقَامٍ.
subchannels.synthesis: The same promise structure that failed in 14:22 is here negated as a possibility of failure. Promise, threat, delegated message, might, and retribution form one enforceable commitment rather than an unsupported assurance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Humans postpone response and presume continuity, but warning, historical disclosure, material resistance, and unbroken promise converge on an irreversible appointed outcome.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:44-47: أَنْذِرِ، يَأْتِيهِمُ الْعَذَابُ، أَخِّرْنَا إِلَى أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ، نُجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ، نَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَ، أَقْسَمْتُمْ، مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ زَوَالٍ، سَكَنْتُمْ فِي مَسَاكِنِ، تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ، ضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْأَمْثَالَ، مَكَرُوا مَكْرَهُمْ، لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ، مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ، عَزِيزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The plot root opens an irrigation-and-spoilage scene, while mountain roots supply excavation resistance, woven density, and cohesive ground; the comparison tests how far covert human action can alter a resistant order.

parent_channels.name: P4 (14:42-52): Reconstituted Stage and Fitted Punishment

subchannels.scene_or_process: Ground and sky change form, all occupants emerge onto open terrain, and singular domination becomes unavoidable.

subchannels.name: Paired Bodies in Fettered Conjunction

subchannels.synthesis: Conjunction is the operative image: individuals are made companions through physical binding, while body, soul, and acquired crime are brought into one visible relation. Association now takes the form of inescapable fitted accountability.

subchannels.name: Tar Garments and Enveloping Fire
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flowing tar is fitted as clothing, while fire covers faces and alters flesh through heat.

subchannels.synthesis: Punishment is fitted at two scales: tar adheres as the body's garment, and fire extends over the face from outside. Flow, cover, heat, and altered flesh turn clothing from protection into a material that sustains exposure.

subchannels.name: Equivalent Repayment and Rapid Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: Every self receives an equivalent settlement for what it acquired, and the account is closed without delay.
subchannels.active_motifs: equivalent repayment `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; settling a debt `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; worshipped deity `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; totality `quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`; self `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; acquired gain `quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`; acquisition `quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`; speed `quranic:root_000698:B001/m01`; account and calculation `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:49, 51: الْمُجْرِمِينَ، لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ، كُلَّ نَفْسٍ، مَا كَسَبَتْ، سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ.
subchannels.synthesis: Recompense is rendered as exact financial settlement rather than undifferentiated penalty. Each self's acquisition fixes the equivalent due, while speed characterizes completion of the account rather than approximation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment remakes the shared environment, exposes every participant, fits bodies into constrained relations and materials, and settles each acquisition by exact account.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:48-51: تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ، بَرَزُوا، الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ، الْمُجْرِمِينَ، مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ، سَرَابِيلُهُمْ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ، تَغْشَى وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ، لِيَجْزِيَ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ، سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ.

parent_channels.name: P4 (14:42-52): Message Reaches Its Cognitive End

subchannels.name: Delivery That Reaches Its Audience
subchannels.scene_or_process: A public communication reaches its intended destination and becomes an effective warning.
subchannels.active_motifs: reaching a goal `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; delivering a message `quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`; eloquence reaching intended meaning `quranic:root_000151:B004/m01`; people as audience `quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`; warning `quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:52: بَلَاغٌ، لِلنَّاسِ، لِيُنْذَرُوا، بِهِ.
subchannels.synthesis: Delivery is measured by arrival, not emission. The same root binds destination, message-bearing, and eloquence, so warning succeeds when wording and audience meet at the intended cognitive point.

subchannels.name: Distinguishing Knowledge and Recollection
subchannels.scene_or_process: The received message unveils a distinguishing sign, establishes singular deity, and prompts the inner core to recover knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: unveiled knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; distinguishing sign `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; worshipped deity `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; divine unity `quranic:root_001631:B004/m01`; recall after forgetting `quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`; reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; pure intellect `quranic:root_001338:B004/m01`; inner core `quranic:root_001338:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 14:52: لِيَعْلَمُوا، إِلَهٌ، وَاحِدٌ، لِيَذَّكَّرَ، أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ.
subchannels.synthesis: Knowledge here is discriminating recognition: the sign separates one divine center from alternatives. Recollection then reaches the “core,” presenting understanding as recovered interior orientation rather than newly stored information alone.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communication is complete only when public delivery produces warning, distinguishing knowledge, unification, and recollection in the inner intellect.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 14:52: هَذَا بَلَاغٌ لِلنَّاسِ، لِيُنْذَرُوا بِهِ، لِيَعْلَمُوا، إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ، لِيَذَّكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: “Reaching” joins destination and eloquence, while the intellect is pictured as an inner core capable of recovering what had been forgotten.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 (14:1-15): Gratitude Becomes Visible Yield
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Recognition of an allotted good becomes visible as sufficiency, fullness, new growth, and increase; concealment interrupts that yield.
parent_channels.active_motifs: blessing and good condition `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`; recognizing blessing `quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`; a little proving sufficient and leaving a visible effect `quranic:root_000810:B002/m01`; fullness like abundant milk `quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`; new shoot or sprout `quranic:root_000810:B004/m01`; growth and increase `quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`; covering a blessing `quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`; praise `quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 14:5-8: شَكُورٍ، نِعْمَةَ، شَكَرْتُمْ، لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ، كَفَرْتُمْ، غَنِيٌّ، حَمِيدٌ.
parent_channels.synthesis: Gratitude is activated as a productive response rather than a verbal label. Recognition makes the gift show in sufficiency, fullness, and fresh growth; increase extends that yield, while covering the blessing blocks its visibility. This formed process remains local but does not require the coercion or messenger scenes as a parent.

parent_channels.name: S2. Whole-surah: A Written Contract of Release
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An owner and an owned servant execute a written manumission compact whose staged obligation is dictated, recorded, and given a document title.
parent_channels.active_motifs: owned servant `quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`; owning hand `quranic:root_001693:B004/m01`; manumission contract with scheduled payments `quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`; dictation to a writer `quranic:root_001445:B004/m01`; document title `quranic:root_001041:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Ownership, writing, dictation, instalments, and titling form one legal passage from servitude toward freedom. This materializes the surah's primary movement from darkness and subjection into light as document-mediated release: a binding word opens freedom through an acknowledged relation and fulfilled obligation, not through self-authorized escape.

parent_channels.name: S3. Whole-surah: Livestock Brought to the Sanctuary Blade
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Livestock designated as a gift is brought within a sanctuary boundary, constituted as an offering for nearness, and met at the sacrificial station by the throat-blade that stills the victim.
parent_channels.active_motifs: livestock wealth, especially camels `quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`; gift driven to the sanctuary `quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`; sanctuary precinct `quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`; offering made for nearness to God `quranic:root_001212:B005/m01`; throat slaughter `quranic:root_000508:B001/m01`; sacrificial knife `quranic:root_000508:B003/m01`; altar or sacrificial station `quranic:root_000508:B003/m02`; blade that stills the victim `quranic:root_000726:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Animal, destination, offering relation, station, tool, bodily operation, and stillness complete a directed sacrificial rite. This supports and materializes Ibrahim's sanctuary sequence as enacted nearness, while usefully pressuring the primary account of 14:6: coerced child-slaughter shares the throat and blade but lacks the gift relation, protected destination, and devotional end of an offering.

parent_channels.name: S4. Whole-surah: The Pot Lowered from the Fire
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Flesh cooks in a pot until fire draws out its liquid and weakens it, while a dedicated cloth lowers the hot vessel and protects the handler.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cooking pot `quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`; cloth for lowering a pot from fire `quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`; roasting or cooking heat `quranic:root_000879:B001/m01`; flesh changed and made to run with liquid under fire `quranic:root_001266:B002/m01`; strength or sharpness deadened by cooking `quranic:root_001454:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Vessel, flesh, heat, rendered liquid, weakening, and heat-cloth form a complete cooking mechanism. This materializes the surah's primary fire judgment as processing that changes flesh, and the protective cloth usefully pressures the tar-garment image: what normally separates a hand from heat is reversed into clothing that binds the body to fire.

parent_channels.name: S5. Whole-surah: Lot-Arrows in a Wager
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Gaming arrows are held in a leather case, the numbered fifth lot participates in a wager, and victory by deception deprives the rival of the share he expected.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather case holding gaming arrows `quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`; fifth gaming arrow or lot `quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`; wagering contest won by deception `quranic:root_001255:B007/m01`; gambling victory that withholds an expected share `quranic:root_000313:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Container, numbered lot, contest, deceptive victory, and lost share form a compact gaming scene. This usefully pressures the surah's primary exchange-and-account reading: false promise and worldly gain resemble a wager whose apparatus stages order while permitting deception, whereas final recompense settles each self's acquisition exactly rather than by chance.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole-surah: Milk Retained, Drawn, and Renewed
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An udder fills, careful fingertip milking draws a small flow, a retained trace prompts the next milk, the udder replenishes between milkings, and continued yield is worked until butter appears.
parent_channels.active_motifs: udder filling and gathering milk `quranic:root_000555:B007/m01`; fingertip milking and its small flow `quranic:root_001165:B005/m01`; retained milk that calls forth the next flow `quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`; milk returning between milkings `quranic:root_001188:B006/m01`; continuous milk yield `quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`; milk gathering and producing butter in the churn `quranic:root_000205:B004/m01`; abundant full milk after pasture `quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Fullness, measured extraction, retained starter, replenishment, continuing flow, and transformation into butter make provision a managed cycle rather than a static possession. This materializes the surah's primary provision-and-gratitude reading: a gift becomes fruitful through careful receipt, restraint, return, and renewed yield rather than one-time seizure.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole-surah: Perfume Pounded and Applied
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A fragrant substance is pounded on a broad slab with a hard smooth crushing stone, then applied to another surface as an aromatic coating.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fragrant substance used as perfume `quranic:root_000961:B007/m01`; broad stone slab for pounding perfume `quranic:root_000879:B008/m01`; hard smooth crushing stone `quranic:root_001266:B004/m01`; preparation and application of an aromatic coating `quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Aromatic material, pounding bed, crushing tool, preparation, and coating form a complete perfume craft. This reframes the primary good-word image of 14:24 as crafted fragrance: its goodness is not merely an abstract quality but a prepared effect that passes beyond its small material source and adheres to what receives it.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole-surah: Kohl Prepared and Turned in the Eye
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Soot pigment is prepared as kohl on a mirror, taken up on a slender applicator, turned within the seeing eye, and ordinarily released through eyelid movement and a returning gaze.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wick or fat soot used as kohl `quranic:root_001564:B008/m01`; kohl material rubbed on a mirror `quranic:root_000848:B013/m01`; applicator rod turned in the eye `quranic:root_001445:B007/m01`; seeing eye `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; blink and edge of gaze `quranic:root_000931:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Pigment, preparation surface, applicator, eye, and blink form a controlled sequence of bodily care. This usefully pressures the primary judgment scene of 14:42-43: an eye normally receives a measured stroke and regains control through lid and gaze, but terror arrests the eyes and denies the returning glance.

parent_channels.name: S9. Whole-surah: A Smelted and Gilded Cult Image
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Metal is melted and refined as bellows expel its dross; a copper cult body is then made to present a more precious surface through gold plating.
parent_channels.active_motifs: molten copper `quranic:root_001238:B006/m01`; smelting dross expelled by bellows `quranic:root_000386:B002/m01`; gold metal `quranic:root_000522:B001/m01`; gilding with gold `quranic:root_000522:B002/m01`; plating base metal to present a false precious surface `quranic:root_001458:B005/m01`; idol body made from wood, silver, or copper `quranic:root_000886:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Melted metal, expelled waste, idol body, precious metal, and deceptive coating form one manufacturing sequence. This materializes and reframes the primary warning against idols and substituted rivals: their apparent preciousness is engineered at the surface, concealing the base composition beneath the object offered as divine.

parent_channels.name: S10. P1→P2→P3→P4: A Guided Procession Becomes Compulsory Rush
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Road users move behind a guide, follow traces one by one, catch the one ahead, and continue as a procession whose easy gait is finally reversed into rapid, plunging travel.
parent_channels.active_motifs: road users and travelers `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`; guide or leading front `quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`; catching the one ahead `quranic:root_000175:B002/m01`; tracking trace after trace `quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`; uninterrupted following sequence `quranic:root_000175:B004/m01`; easy gait `quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`; rapid or plunging travel `quranic:root_001609:B008/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: P1 supplies road, guide, and measured dispatch; P2 places followers behind leaders; P3 makes the identity of the followed guide decisive; P4 records the late wish to follow and converts controlled movement into haste without recovered agency. The bridge reframes guidance as pace and relational order as well as direction: failure to follow while choice remains becomes compulsory advance when the destination can no longer be changed.

parent_channels.name: S11. P1→P2→P3→P4: A Right Carried from Deed to Restitution
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The holder of a documented right advances a claim, establishes it by proof before a judge, collects what is due, and receives the right back.
parent_channels.active_motifs: claimant pursuing a right `quranic:root_000175:B005/m01`; specifically owned right `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`; deed or certificate of right `quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`; proof establishing the claim `quranic:root_000192:B006/m01`; judgment between people `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; payment and collection of the right `quranic:root_001237:B006/m01`; return of the right to its owner `quranic:root_000609:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The shared invariant is preservation of entitlement while participants and stages change: a right remains identifiable from written deed through proof and judgment to satisfaction. This causal bridge reframes the surah's final account as restitution rather than sudden penalty; delay does not dissolve the claim because its deed, proof, and claimant continue toward return.

parent_channels.name: S12. P2→P3→P4: Stipulated Wage Reversed into Corvee
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Workers perform a task for an assigned wage that causes gain to accrue to them, while the opposed labor regime compels service without compensation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: manual workers or craftsmen `quranic:root_001167:B003/m01`; worker's wage or livelihood `quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`; reward stipulated for a task `quranic:root_000248:B005/m01`; causing another to earn gain `quranic:root_001296:B002/m01`; compelled labor without wage `quranic:root_000685:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is an exact contrast in labor relation, not in activity: one arrangement names the worker, fixes compensation, and transfers gain, while the other takes work without wage. This usefully pressures P3's harnessed cosmos as service ordered toward provision rather than exploitative corvee, while P4 restores the question of what is due for every performed act.

parent_channels.name: S13. P1→P2→P3→P4: Income Entered, Assessed, and Paid Out
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Income is received into a holding, a levy is imposed on person, property, or land, money leaves along its specified channel, and the assessed tribute is paid.
parent_channels.active_motifs: income entering an estate `quranic:root_000464:B006/m01`; levy imposed on a person or property `quranic:root_000906:B010/m01`; money exiting as a fixed obligation `quranic:root_000400:B003/m01`; tribute or tax delivered `quranic:root_000009:B008/m01`; financial payment discharging what is due `quranic:root_000244:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Receipt, assessment, outflow, and satisfaction form one complete revenue circuit across the surah. This causal bridge materializes the movement from bestowed resources to exact account: what enters possession remains answerable to an assigned due, while freely circulating expenditure and imposed levy differ in agency even though both send wealth outward.

parent_channels.name: S14. P3 (14:28-41): The Bargained Sale and Its Rescission
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A food seller displays merchandise, the parties bargain and state its value, an advance is paid, they transact, and the sale may be unwound by returning the goods.
parent_channels.active_motifs: food seller `quranic:root_000095:B005/m01`; merchandise offered for sale `quranic:root_000169:B002/m01`; bargaining and stating a price `quranic:root_000764:B001/m01`; valuation and pricing `quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`; advance payment in a sale `quranic:root_000737:B005/m01`; transaction between parties `quranic:root_001046:B005/m01`; return and rescission of a sale `quranic:root_000555:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 14:6, 9, 18, 23, 28, 31, 40-43, 48: يَسُومُونَكُمْ، رَدُّوا، أَعْمَالُهُمْ، سَلَامٌ، عَمِلُوا، بَدَّلُوا، بَيْعٌ، يُقِيمُوا، مُقِيمَ، يَقُومُ، يَعْمَلُ، يَرْتَدُّ، تُبَدَّلُ.
parent_channels.synthesis: Offer, negotiation, valuation, advance, completed dealing, and rescission form the full life cycle of a sale. This materializes the primary warning in 14:31: the coming day without sale closes not just payment but every market operation by which people normally renegotiate value, transfer goods, or reverse a bad bargain.

parent_channels.name: S15. P3 (14:28-41): Food Passed as a Gift, Then Recalled
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Food is heaped on a cloth and palm-strip plate, sent as a gift to a friend, passed hand to hand, and later converted into a burden when the giver recounts the favor.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tablecloth and heaped food `quranic:root_000840:B011/m01`; palm-strip plate for food or gifts `quranic:root_001263:B006/m01`; gift sent to a loved person `quranic:root_001583:B004/m01`; hand-to-hand passing `quranic:root_001693:B007/m01`; giver burdening the recipient by recalling a favor `quranic:root_001449:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Food, serving surface, gift vessel, affectionate destination, manual transfer, and retrospective speech complete a hospitality scene. It materializes P3's provision and expenditure as goods made shareable, while the recalled favor usefully pressures the surah's gratitude reading: benefaction becomes domination when the giver uses memory of the gift to weigh down its recipient.

parent_channels.name: S16. P2→P3: The Full Bucket from a Permanent Well
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A permanent well in grazing land yields a full bucket balanced by its crosspiece; the drawn water fills a waterskin and reaches the drinker as sweet and palatable.
parent_channels.active_motifs: well in grazing land `quranic:root_000227:B010/m01`; permanent well whose water does not cease `quranic:root_000989:B004/m01`; large full bucket `quranic:root_000521:B007/m01`; bucket crosspiece balancing the load `quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`; waterskin for drawn water `quranic:root_001212:B009/m01`; sweet palatable water `quranic:root_000994:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Water source, persistence, lifting vessel, load-balancing component, receiving skin, and drinkable outcome form one extraction sequence. This materializes P3's provision as accessible through a fitted chain of source and tools; by contrast, P2's liquid reaches the mouth under compulsion yet never becomes a received, sustaining drink.

parent_channels.name: S17. P3 (14:28-41): Stored Water Released to Harvest
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Well, canal, or rainwater collects in a broad reservoir and rock hollow, then issues through an outlet into fields until the irrigated crop reaches harvest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: reservoir that gathers water and releases it to crops `quranic:root_000016:B007/m01`; rock hollow retaining rainwater `quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`; water issuing from an outlet into fields `quranic:root_001124:B005/m01`; river mouth or outlet `quranic:root_001190:B004/m01`; harvested crop `quranic:root_000630:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Collection, retention, controlled release, field entry, and harvest form a complete irrigation mechanism. It materializes P3's primary sky-water-fruit sequence by supplying the middle operations between descent and yield, and sharpens the barren-valley petition of 14:37 as a request for a missing storage-and-release pathway rather than for undifferentiated abundance.

parent_channels.name: S18. P2→P4: The Dead Carried, Shrouded, and Housed
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A human body is placed on a bier, carried, wrapped and concealed, and deposited in a grave understood as the dead person's house.
parent_channels.active_motifs: human body lying or raised `quranic:root_000221:B002/m01`; funeral bier or carrier `quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`; shroud covering the dead `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; burial concealing the dead `quranic:root_000266:B009/m02`; grave as the dead person's house `quranic:root_000166:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Body, carrier, shroud, concealment, and grave-house complete the ordinary terminal passage. This usefully pressures P2's death that approaches from every side without allowing death: the expected sequence cannot discharge into burial. P4 then reverses the grave's housing function as the transformed earth and universal appearance before God remove final concealment.

parent_channels.name: S19. P4 (14:42-52): The Moonlit Snare and the Checked Prey
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hunters go out at moonlight to seek prey whose sight is impaired, set snares with dangling cords, catch the quarry, and inspect it to determine whether the strike killed it.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hunters going out for game `quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`; seeking prey by moonlight when its sight is impaired `quranic:root_001255:B003/m01`; hunter's snare `quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`; traps set for prey `quranic:root_000879:B004/m01`; dangling cord of a snare `quranic:root_000994:B006/m01`; checking whether struck prey is dead `quranic:root_001454:B014/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 14:17, 22, 31, 33, 37, 40, 44, 48: الْمَوْتُ، أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ، الصَّلَاةَ، الْقَمَرَ، مُقِيمِي الصَّلَاةِ، عَذَابُ، السَّمَاوَاتُ.
parent_channels.synthesis: Nocturnal setting, impaired quarry, hunter, laid apparatus, catching cord, and verification form a complete capture scene. This materializes the primary plotting of 14:46 as staged entrapment rather than thought alone: concealment and compromised sight let the apparatus do its work, while the final inspection anticipates judgment's disclosure of what the scheme actually accomplished.

parent_channels.name: S20. P2 (14:16-27): Termites Inside the Load-Bearing Frame
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Wood-eating insects consume a crosswise beam within an interlocked wooden frame until corrosion reaches the structure's supporting members.
parent_channels.active_motifs: termite or wood-eating insect `quranic:root_000025:B010/m01`; crosswise load-bearing beam `quranic:root_000243:B007/m01`; interlocked wooden support frame `quranic:root_000777:B004/m01`; corrosion and eating-away `quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Pest, material, beam, frame, and progressive decay form a hidden structural-failure mechanism. This materializes P2's bad tree with no stability: visible members may remain aligned while their carrying substance is eaten away, so eventual uprooting exposes an earlier loss of internal support rather than a merely sudden fall.

parent_channels.name: S21. P1→P3: The Hidden Fetus Received into the Midwife's Hand
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The womb houses a hidden fetus, labor draws near, a midwife receives the emerging child into her hand, birth completes, and the umbilical remnant is cut.
parent_channels.active_motifs: womb as the child's seedbed and house `quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`; fetus hidden in the womb `quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`; labor drawing near `quranic:root_001212:B012/m01`; midwife receiving the newborn into her hand `quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`; birth and placing down the pregnancy `quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`; infant navel and cut umbilical remnant `quranic:root_000697:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Gestational place, concealed child, approaching labor, receiving specialist, delivery, and bodily separation form a complete birth sequence. It supports and materializes P3's account of offspring as a received gift, while usefully pressuring P1's child-slaughter as the violent cancellation of a prior womb-to-hand process of protection, emergence, and care.
